model_annotation: This chart illustrates the training set size (训练集数量), validation set size (验证集数量), and accuracy (准确率) across five task categories. The horizontal axis contains five categorical labels in Chinese: 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition), arranged from left to right. The left vertical axis represents the dataset count, scaled linearly from 0 to 1200, while the right vertical axis represents accuracy, scaled linearly from 0 to 1.0. For each category, a pair of grouped bars is displayed, with the blue bar representing the training set size and the orange bar representing the validation set size, accompanied by a gray line connecting data points that represent accuracy values. For 实体识别, the blue bar reaches 1102 and the orange bar reaches 250, with an accuracy of 0.7666. For 角色识别, the blue bar reaches 1095 and the orange bar reaches 190, with an accuracy of 0.8714. For 异常识别, the blue bar reaches 1077 and the orange bar reaches 40, with an accuracy of 0.692. For 空间推理, the blue bar reaches 1210 (the tallest blue bar) and the orange bar reaches 675 (the tallest orange bar), with an accuracy of 0.2852 (the lowest accuracy). For 同义识别, the blue bar reaches only 5 (the shortest blue bar) and the orange bar reaches 55, with an accuracy of 0.3769. The bars are not sorted in any particular ascending or descending order, and each bar is annotated with its exact numeric value displayed above it. The accuracy line points are also labeled with their precise values. No bars appear to be visually emphasized through bolding or outlining beyond the standard color coding described in the legend.
